newsitem.title: USA: CSX, Norfolk Southern to file plan soon.
newsitem.headline: CSX, Norfolk Southern to file plan soon.

text.p: Railroads CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp said they plan to file their plan for the proposed acquisition of Conrail Inc with the federal Surface Transportation Board within several days.

The filing originally was expected on Monday or Tuesday, but has been delayed due to the complexity of the document, which contains more than 15,000 pages, the prospective buyers said in a joint news release.
Sources familiar with the plan told Reuters there were no other reasons for the delay and the proposed transaction was not in jeopardy.

CSX and Norfolk Southern are seeking approval to buy the East Coast railroad for $10.3 billion in a joint transaction. The all-cash deal calls for Norfolk to pay $5.9 billion for 58 percent of Conrail and CSX to pay $4.3 billion for the rest.
The plan to be submitted to the federal agency is expected to contain details about capital expenditures, cost savings and other key aspects of the transaction.
